doc: marks — what a range of a node's text is (S-17): emphasis, a run of code, the place of a link. A mark states a meaning, not a look; where ARIA has a role of the same meaning it is named. Append-only: the order is the enumerator's value.

mark.name: underline
mark.doc: Text set apart by a line under it, with no further meaning.

mark.name: math
mark.doc: A formula in the line, in its source notation.

mark.name: math_display
mark.doc: A formula set on its own, in its source notation.

mark.name: raw
mark.doc: Markup embedded in the text, verbatim; written out as markup only where the node's origin is `app` (S-3).

mark.name: link
mark.doc: The place of a link: the child node it names holds the address.

mark.name: image
mark.doc: The place of an image: the range is its text alternative, the child node it names holds the source.
